description:
You are a FinOps analyst analyzing cloud cost usage. In the directory /home/user/cloud_costs, there is a CSV file named monthly_report.csv containing daily cloud spend records in the following columns: date, project, service, cost (for example, 2024-06-01,analytics,compute,24.56). 

Your objective is to generate a summary and extract high-usage entries as follows:

1. Use a text-processing command to calculate the total spend (sum of the "cost" column) for the month and save this single value into /home/user/cloud_costs/total_spend.txt. The output file should contain exactly one line formatted as: 
Total Spend: <value>
where <value> is the sum rounded to two decimal places.

2. Using a text-processing command, extract all lines from monthly_report.csv where the cost is greater than 30.00 and save them to /home/user/cloud_costs/high_usage.csv, preserving the header row from the original CSV and maintaining the CSV format.

When finished, verify that both /home/user/cloud_costs/total_spend.txt and /home/user/cloud_costs/high_usage.csv exist with the correct contents as specified.
truth:
# Pre-existing file:
/home/user/cloud_costs/monthly_report.csv
(with the following contents)
date,project,service,cost
2024-06-01,analytics,compute,24.56
2024-06-02,storage,storage,31.22
2024-06-03,analytics,compute,35.44
2024-06-04,web,cdn,12.10
2024-06-05,storage,backup,29.99
2024-06-06,analytics,compute,40.08

# Expected output files:
/home/user/cloud_costs/total_spend.txt
(should contain exactly:)
Total Spend: 173.39

/home/user/cloud_costs/high_usage.csv
(should contain exactly:)
date,project,service,cost
2024-06-02,storage,storage,31.22
2024-06-03,analytics,compute,35.44
2024-06-06,analytics,compute,40.08
